alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 23 at 10:55AM PST until November 23 at 11:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
Visibility has improved at most locations and will continue to
improve into this afternoon, so the Dense Fog Advisory will be
allowed to expire.
